facts.value: Little direct effect on the build: the campus stands on the Oct 15, 2025 consent judgment, not on a township ordinance. The board reversed its own rezoning on Jan 28, 2026 and the developers said the project proceeds under the judgment. The notes are exposed only if the judgment itself falls; the one bid to reopen it was denied as untimely on Feb 20, 2026.
quote: The Saline Township Board voted Wednesday to maintain agricultural zoning for more than 500 acres slated for a massive AI data center, though developers say the project will proceed as planned under an existing consent judgment
A court cannot order a municipal entity to zone any particular way.

facts.value: Bond and tax deal would unwind: the county title-and-lease structure under the $165B bond ordinances, which the project and presumably the lenders' collateral sit on, would have to be rebuilt, and the property-tax abatement could be lost. The suits are past the motion to dismiss; no merits ruling yet.
